flags.why: This question-final particle is mainly literary and would sound affected in ordinary casual conversation.
The entry omits the everyday meaning of giving or assigning a name.
flags.fix: Add: verb | to name; to give a name. Example: Họ đặt tên con là An. = They named their child An.

flags.why: The common adjective meaning separate or loose is missing.
flags.fix: Add: adj | separate; loose; detached. Example: Tôi ghi số điện thoại vào một tờ giấy rời. = I wrote the phone number on a loose sheet of paper.

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of treating someone by paying for their food or drink.
flags.fix: Add: verb | to treat (pay for someone's food or drink). Example: Bữa này tôi mời. = This meal is on me.

flags.why: Tiệt nòi giống means to wipe out a lineage, not to sterilise someone or make them unable to reproduce.
flags.fix: to wipe out; to eradicate completely
